source.author: James F. Babb
source.erratum: ApJS 237,20 (2018), author errata: the prefactor in Eq.9 is 7.80e-26. The original 1.475e-20 is not used to compute a radiative-association rate.
source.table_selection: Only dipole-matrix-element squared values greater than 1e-6 are listed. A transition-selected table need not contain every bound level. The level count must be measured.
source.energies: The E(v,N) column is the positive magnitude of binding to the H(1s)+H+ dissociation limit in cm^-1, not the excitation energy above (0,0). Excitation term value is D00-DvN.
source.approximation: Born-Oppenheimer potential; adiabatic, nonadiabatic, relativistic and radiative corrections omitted. The reported count is the parent claim, not an independently certified complete spectrum.

interval_scope: The positive fixed subset sum per electron-spin state, with normalized even/odd nuclear weights 1/4 and 3/4. Each excitation energy is a difference of two printed binding energies, so +/-0.01 cm^-1 covers a scenario of +/-0.005 for each printed entry. This is not a physical energy-uncertainty bound. A constant electron-spin degeneracy 2 adds ln(2) to log Q; derivatives of orders >=1 are unchanged. Missing levels, plasma occupation and the complete EOS are excluded.
